audience: teams that record client calls, sales calls and all-hands meetings with Recall.ai bots

useCases.title: Check which bots are in a meeting now
useCases.text: List the meeting bots in the workspace with their status and meeting URL. Get one bot to see its status changes and recordings.

useCases.title: Send a bot to a client call
useCases.text: Create a recording bot for a meeting now, or for a set join time. Then get the bot to check whether it has joined.

useCases.title: Get the transcript of a recorded meeting
useCases.text: List the recordings of a bot, then get one recording with its download links. Get the transcript with its status and download link.

useCases.title: Post a message in a meeting chat
useCases.text: Send a chat message as the bot. The other participants in the meeting see it.

useCases.title: Remove a bot from a call
useCases.text: Make a bot leave a meeting now. Delete a scheduled bot that has not joined a call yet.
